🔑 Magnum v4 72B — Free API Key Portal

anthracite-org/magnum-v4-72b static free demo

This page issues your own free demo keys (mk-…) in this browser via localStorage. It does not mint real OpenRouter / Anthropic / OpenAI keys. For live model calls, bring your own upstream key from a free tier (OpenRouter, Hugging Face Inference, or Puter.js user-pays). Full local gateway with OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions lives in magnum-key-portal/server.js.

1. Create a free key

No key yet — press Create key.

Quota: 50,000 demo tokens per key, tracked locally. Stored only in your browser.

2. Test chat (offline mock)

Response appears here.

3. Wire to your studio app 📱

Option A — phone-ready now (recommended):
Model: anthracite-org/magnum-v4-72b
Base URL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
Key: sk-or-YOUR-KEY (from openrouter.ai/keys)

Option B — via portal gateway (same WiFi):
Run PORT=3002 node magnum-key-portal/server.js on your PC, create a mk-... key, then Base URL: http://YOUR-PC-IP:3002/v1, Key: mk-...

Full copy-paste JSON: wire.json. Runner mk-... keys live only on the machine running the gateway — create your own on your PC. Without OPENROUTER_API_KEY the gateway returns mock demo text.

4. Use from code

Create a key above to see your snippet.

Live gateway: OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... PORT=3002 node magnum-key-portal/server.js, then POST /v1/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer mk-... and model: anthracite-org/magnum-v4-72b.
